name: ugot-mindset
description: How the agent should think and talk with the user: read the intent, declare requirements before the first tool call, verify before claiming, picture first, blame the instrument before the result, solve before saying impossible, keep going, brief human answers. 31 skills, 2 agents and automatic prompt/result/stop/bash gates.
author: edu-ide

name: ugot-writing
description: Reader-first writing (mainly Korean): style editing, applications, songs and lyrics, story craft, short-form ads, and CriticMarkup evidence notes on every claim (criticmarkup). Explaining with pictures moved to ugot-mindset (visual-first). Working-copy skill runs with per-requirement CriticMarkup notes (skill-run).
author: edu-ide

name: ugot-engineering-habits
description: Engineering habits for coding agents: build it right the first time, check the latest literature, disclose shortcuts, premortem before claims, use fundamental terms, consult on architecture, separate incident mitigation from the root fix.
author: edu-ide

name: ugot-career
description: Job applications for developers who work with AI coding tools: screen postings, dissect requirements, research the company, build a tailored resume and portfolio story, submit and track.
author: edu-ide
